plain.text: Jesus said some standing there would see God's kingdom come with power. Six days later, he took Peter, James and John up a high mountain. There his appearance was changed: his clothes became dazzling white. Elijah and Moses appeared, talking with Jesus. Peter, frightened, suggested building three shelters. A cloud covered them, and a voice said, "This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!" Suddenly they saw only Jesus. Coming down, Jesus told them not to tell anyone until the Son of Man had risen from the dead. He said that Elijah had indeed come already.

They found the other disciples arguing with a crowd. A father had brought his son, who had a spirit that threw him to the ground and made him unable to speak. The disciples could not drive it out. The father said, "If you can do anything, take pity on us and help us." Jesus said, "'If you can'? Everything is possible for one who believes." The father cried out, "I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!" Jesus commanded the spirit to leave, and the boy was freed. Later Jesus told his disciples, "This kind can come out only by prayer."
Jesus taught his disciples again: "The Son of Man will be betrayed and killed, and after three days he will rise." They did not understand and were afraid to ask him.

In Capernaum, Jesus asked what they had been arguing about on the road. They were silent, because they had argued about who was the greatest. Jesus said, "Anyone who wants to be first must be last of all and servant of all." He took a little child in his arms and said that whoever welcomes a child like this in his name welcomes him. When John said they had stopped someone driving out demons in Jesus' name because he was not one of them, Jesus said, "Do not stop him. Whoever is not against us is for us." Even giving someone a cup of water in his name will be rewarded.

Jesus warned strongly against causing a "little one" who believes to stumble. He used vivid pictures: if your hand, foot or eye causes you to sin, it would be better to lose it than to be thrown into hell. Nothing is worth losing eternal life over.
"Everyone will be salted with fire," Jesus said. "Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with each other."

summary.bigIdea: Jesus is revealed in glory as God's beloved Son, and true greatness is found in serving others.
points: On the mountain, God tells the disciples: "This is my Son... Listen to him!"
A struggling father prays, "I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!"
The greatest is the one who serves, and welcomes the little ones.
summary.reflection: Can you pray the father's honest prayer: "I believe; help my unbelief"? Where do you need it?
